import React from 'react' import { Button } from '../Button' import type { JobKind, JobState } from '../../types/practice' const work: Record = { generation: 'Preparing a sentence', check: 'Checking your answer', reveal: 'Revealing the reference', replay: 'Loading saved replay', history: 'Loading personal results', } interface JobStatusProps { job: JobState onCancel: () => void onResume: () => void } /** Honest, indeterminate progress. No percentages, queue positions or estimates. */ export function JobStatus({ job, onCancel, onResume }: JobStatusProps) { if (!job.kind) return null const visible = ['queued', 'running', 'recovering', 'retry-after', 'delayed', 'uncertain', 'stopping'].includes(job.phase) if (!visible) return null const label = work[job.kind] const paid = job.kind === 'generation' || job.kind === 'check' const resumeLabel = job.kind === 'check' ? 'Resume checking' : 'Resume preparing' let title = label let body: string | null = null let action: React.ReactNode = null const animated = ['queued', 'running', 'recovering', 'stopping'].includes(job.phase) switch (job.phase) { case 'queued': title = `${label} — waiting to start` break case 'running': title = job.resumed ? `${label} — resumed the same request` : label break case 'recovering': title = job.failure === 'wrong-language' ? 'The sentence came back in the wrong language — preparing it again' : 'Connection interrupted — reconnecting to the same request' body = 'Recovering automatically for a short while. Your work is kept.' break case 'retry-after': title = job.retryAfter ? `AI is busy — you can resume in ${job.retryAfter}s` : 'You can resume now' body = 'The service told us when to try again. Resuming continues the same request.' action = ( ) break case 'delayed': title = 'This is taking longer than usual' body = 'Automatic recovery has stopped. Resuming picks up the same request — it doesn’t start a new one.' action = ( ) break case 'uncertain': title = 'We lost the response — your request may still be running' body = 'Get the result before starting anything new. Your answer is kept in this session.' action = ( ) break case 'stopping': title = 'Stopping…' body = paid ? 'Work that already started may still use credits.' : null break default: break } return (
